body: r24-misc (2026-10-07): examples read the port from PORT (default 8081) and second servers from REPORT_PORT, API_PORT, PORT_B, ISSUER_PORT (env names chosen by the agent; PORT is the common convention, so a shell that exports PORT moves every example). oauth Start/Callback typed methods answer ErrProviderUnknown (a plain error, not an auth code) for a provider not in use; without a request in ctx the start's flow binding is dropped and the callback answers ErrStateInvalid. email: an add, change or resend for an address another account verified mails that owner the duplicate sign-up notice instead of the link (changeEmail does the same); the token is still issued so timing matches; a link mailed before the other account verified still answers auth.identity_taken. authhttp drops a cached copy recorded before a session clear in the same response, in cookie mode too, not only bearer.
